svg.text: A. Schedule cost model (GPU): device vs CPU
forced device, gates off, median of 3; >1 = device faster
work items (trips for kernels, arcs for engine steps), log
B. Format model: runtime per forced layout
compiled with AUTOTUNER_FORCE_LAYOUT; all modes must give the same answer
C. CPU region model: predicted vs measured
identity = perfect; band = the 5x contract; gpu-backend rows profile device work
each row names its artifact; ✓ = reproduced after the last source change
